title: Sandbox network allow-list is host-name only: '*' permitted, redirects and internal/metadata hosts not blocked (SSRF)
test_evidence: Commit 05b451a8. Failing-first: main in-process-sandbox.ts + new test -> 1 failed/6 passed (exit 1); fix 7/7. plugin 172/172 at batch head.
notes: Wave-0 unmet step: InProcessSandbox called globalThis.fetch with caller init (redirect follow). It now forces redirect 'manual' and returns the 3xx. The child-process PluginSandbox already uses safeFetch maxRedirects 0 (#698). '*'/blank allow-lists and metadata/private/non-https targets were already blocked on main (egress-policy.ts). Residual: the in-process path resolves DNS again inside fetch (rebinding window); InProcessSandbox refuses untrusted code unless allowUntrustedInProcess is set.

title: Plugin install lets tenant over-consent and skips config/schema, extension-point and status checks on enable
test_evidence: Commits 14079368 (consent ceiling, labelled L479) and ae9ecc30. Failing-first ae9ecc30: HEAD~ plugin-service.ts + new test -> 6 failed/1 passed (exit 1); fix 7/7.
notes: Over-consent rejected (consent may not exceed requiredPermissions). Install validates configuration against configSchema, rejects missing required extension points (when a registry is wired); enable rejects a non-active or incompatible plugin. Unmet: configSchema is checked for type/properties/required/enum/additionalProperties only; full JSON Schema needs a validator dependency (none in the workspace).

title: 'Platform' policy scope is tenant-owned, so platform-level inheritance cannot work and any tenant can author 'platform' policies
test_evidence: Commit 683ce0cc. Revert proof re-run on main b9631abe: the 3 M610 cases fail on main routes.ts (exit 1); branch pass.
notes: Met: only platform admins create, edit or assign platform-scope policies. Unmet: platform policies are still stored and looked up per tenant (evaluation reads platform assignments in the caller's tenant), so platform-level inheritance across tenants does not work; needs a platform-owned storage model (schema/ownership batch, tenancy specialist).
